journal: PNAS (Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences)
snapshot_note: Snapshot for tests and as a starting point. PNAS is format-neutral at first submission but asks for set components. SubmitReady re-reads the live guidelines on every run.

csl_style.title: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

requirements.rule: Any format at first submission, with all required components
requirements.quote: PNAS follows a format-neutral policy for initial submissions, meaning your manuscript does not need to adhere to strict journal formatting guidelines to be considered.

requirements.rule: Significance statement of at most 120 words, for readers outside the field

requirements.quote: Include at least three keywords at submission.

requirements.rule: Title under 135 characters, naming the organism, without acronyms or puns
requirements.quote: Keep the title brief (< 135 characters), descriptive, and comprehensible to a broad scientific audience.

requirements.rule: A major and a minor classification on the title page
requirements.quote: Select both a major and minor classification category.

requirements.rule: Number every page, starting with the title page
requirements.quote: Please number all manuscript pages starting with the title page.

requirements.rule: Recommended order: Abstract, Significance, Introduction, Results, Discussion, Materials and methods, Acknowledgments, References, Figure legends (recommended, not required)
Competing interest information for all authors
requirements.quote: contact and competing interest information for all authors
funding information and whether an open access license has been selected

requirements.rule: ORCID linked in the PNAS profile, not typed in the manuscript
requirements.quote: Do not include ORCIDs in the manuscript file; individual authors must link their ORCID account to their PNAS profile at

requirements.rule: No statements of novelty or priority
requirements.quote: Do not include statements of novelty or priority.

requirements.rule: Links only to permanent public repositories, not personal pages
requirements.quote: Links to an author's personal web page are not acceptable.

requirements.rule: After acceptance: Word, RTF or LaTeX with no embedded figures, tables or schemes
requirements.quote: No embedded figures, tables, or schemes
